title: gitapex runtime compatibility matrix (W2, parent issue #307)
description: Schema for .gitapex/runtime-compatibility-matrix.json -- issue #828's versioned, testable record of how faithfully each target agent-tool runtime can enforce the ten execution-requirement dimensions #307's own W2 names (field parsing, discovery locations, invocation behavior, context loading, tool semantics, path controls, sandbox controls, network controls, MCP lifecycle, plugin/subagent limitations). Mirrors .gitapex/ssot.schema.json's own envelope convention (a `meta` block with schema_version/tracking_issue/status/phase) rather than the per-skill metadata/gitapex.yaml CRD envelope, since this is repo-wide singleton data, not a per-skill sidecar. Distinct from skills/evaluating-skill-quality/references/runtime-compatibility.md, which grades a narrower SKILL.md-frontmatter-standard-compliance axis as prose across a differently-scoped runtime list; this file's ten dimensions (sandbox/network controls, MCP lifecycle, path controls) exist to ground a future W4 enforcement adapter, not a skill-quality warning. `runtimes` is an open, pattern-validated map (no closed enum) since this repository's own evidence already shows the real-world runtime list growing past #307's original six; `dimensions` within one runtime entry is closed to the ten fixed keys W2 names, fail-closed on an unrecognized key like every other gated block in skill-metadata.schema.json. Ships with zero populated runtimes in this first slice -- population is real primary-source research, deferred to follow-up batches.

schema_version.description: Semver of this schema file itself. Bump on any required/additionalProperties change.

tracking_issue.description: The GitHub issue that specs this file's own schema (its first-slice child issue under parent #307).

status.description: Lifecycle of this matrix as a whole, distinct from any single dimension entry's own classification.

phase.description: Population progress, not a numbered engineering phase in the ssot.json sense. phase-0 = schema only, zero runtimes populated. Increment as later batches land real runtime rows.

runtimes.description: runtime id (kebab-case, e.g. claude-code) -> its own compatibility entry. Open map, no closed enum -- see this file's own top-level description for why. Empty object is valid (phase-0's own shipped state).

displayName.description: Human-readable product name, e.g. "Claude Code" for the claude-code key.

dimensions.description: Closed to the ten dimension keys #307's own W2 text names. Each is individually optional -- population lands dimension-by-dimension across follow-up batches -- but at least one must be present for a runtime entry to exist at all (an entry with zero populated dimensions has nothing to say and should not exist yet).

classification.description: How faithfully this runtime maps this dimension against the sidecar-declared requirement it would need to enforce, per #307's own W2 text (its prose uses lowercase; this schema uses PascalCase to match every other enum in this repository's own metadata conventions, e.g. spec.portability's Portable/Repository-scoped/Mixed).

primarySource.description: Full https:// URL to the vendor's own current documentation this classification is grounded in -- never a memory-based claim, per this repository's own grounding-in-primary-sources discipline.

observedVersion.description: Free-form: the runtime version/release this classification was observed against. No shared pattern -- vendor versioning schemes differ too much (semver, date-based, rolling release with no discrete version).

snapshotDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD the primary source was actually read. Refresh before asserting current behavior, matching runtime-compatibility.md's own established convention.

notes.description: Free-text elaboration, capped the same way spec.references[].summary is elsewhere in this repository's own metadata conventions.
